name: Chris
source:
In episode 3, Chris has graduated and now is working in the most prestigious bank on the Lunar Surface.
[spoiler]After being turned down by Hal, Chris moved on with her goal: To live the life however she want to. She hasn't visit Lisa for a long time. She has created a new investment system that makes Hal doubted his skills.[/spoiler]
